content: दीक्ष् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (दीक्षते, दीक्षित) .²1 To consecrate or prepare oneself for the performance of a sacred rite; दीक्षयस्व त्वमात्मानम् <ls>Mb. 14. 71. 21</ls>; see दीक्षित below. .²2 To dedicate oneself to. .²3 To initiate or introduce a pupil. .²4 To invest with the sacred thread. .²5 To sacrifice. .²6 To practise self-restraint. .²7 To shave oneʼs head, to be shaved. .²8 {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} impel; induce तत्कलमस्तमदिदीक्षत क्षणं तालवृन्तचलनाय नायकम् <ls>N. 18. 120</ls>.
